categorisation: This gazette notification exercises powers under the Societies Ordinance (a legal statute) to authorize the purpose of a specific society. The content focuses on regulatory action under existing legislation, making it a Legal/Regulatory matter rather than a government personnel or structural change. The mention of the Prime Minister's name and title is incidental to the legal authorization being granted.
